about: Greg Westfall is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. He works at Cantey Hanger LLP, located in Fort Worth, Texas, and provides legal services for issues involving Criminal Defense: White Collar and Civil Litigation: Defense to the surrounding community.
Greg Westfall completed legal studies at Texas Tech University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1993. Greg Westfall passed the bar in 1993.
